question.text: A person of mass 60 kg is inside a lift of mass 940 kg and presses the button on control panel. The lift starts moving upwards with an acceleration $1.0 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^2$. If $\mathrm{g}=10 \mathrm{~ms}^{-2}$, the tension in the supporting cable is

solution.text: Total mass $=(60+940) \mathrm{kg}=1000 \mathrm{~kg}$ Let T be the tension in the supporting cable, then $T-1000 g=1000 \times 1$ $\Rightarrow \mathrm{T}=1000 \times 11=11000 \mathrm{~N}$
